description: Execute code in an ephemeral, MicroVM-isolated sandbox. The VM is hard-purged after execution — no state, no files, nothing persists between calls. Full internet egress; RFC 1918 private ranges are blocked, link-local 169.254.x.x is not. Use return_files to capture output artifacts (charts, CSVs, data files) as base64. Keep secrets out of code strings — pass them via env instead.

env.description: Environment variables injected into the sandbox. Use for secrets and config.

files.description: Files to write before execution. Keys are absolute paths, values are file contents.

return_files.description: File paths to capture after execution and return as base64. Use for charts, CSVs, or any output artifact.

runtime.description: Runtime. python3.12 includes numpy, pandas, matplotlib, requests, and more.

timeout_ms.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds. Exit code 124 signals timeout.

name: scratchrun_exec
